title_en: Dossier of regulations concerning the mysteries at Andania
date: probably 23 AD Justification: the inscription refers to itself as being published in the year preceding year 55 of an era (cf. lines 10-11, 52, 54 and 90). According to Gawlinski (with extensive discussion p. 3-11), the reference should be to the Achaean era of 146 BC, and thus the inscription would date to 91 BC. Themelis has argued against this and in favour of a dating according to the Aktian era. As Stroud ap. SEG 59, 403, notes, only one or two inscriptions, out of 19 late-Hellenistic or Roman instances collected by Gawlinski, are dated according to the Achaean era. This argument was also treated at length by Habicht, with the approval of Rousset in REG 2016 BE no. 207. For arguments in favour of maintaining the earlier date, cf. also Deshours 2006 and 2012. But the debate continues: cf. now Makris, for a review of the evidence and an argument for dating some inscriptions from Messene (ephebic lists) according to the Achaean era.
provenance: Found in a field not far from the village of Polichne . This inscription was discovered in 1858 and incorporated into the wall of the church of Agios Konstantinos in the village of Konstantinoi in Messenia, where it remains today.

segments.zh: 參與祕儀。關於經費：由人民選出的五人團必須收取祕儀所生之經費。所有執政官必須提出提名，不得（提名）同一人兩次，每人須擁有不少於一塔蘭同之資產，長老會必須在（被提名者姓名）旁寫下其資產，同樣也寫下提名者之資產。銀錢檢驗官必須為收取經費者服務。祕儀完成時，他們必須在議會成員的第一次例會中就所有事項作出報告，並必須立即將記錄交給監督官，按標題寫明所收經費。

segments.zh: 來自淨罪之（收入）與首次入教者之入門費，以及其他任何收入，以及所花費之開支，以及如有任何剩餘。他們必須立即將其支付給司庫官，若被發現有任何不當行為，則須承擔司法訴訟之責任，罰款為雙倍金額並加一千德拉克馬，法官不得予以任何減免。於第五十五年任命之人員也必須將城市為冠冕授予姆納西斯特拉托斯的經費，六千德拉克馬，支付給他。他們必須將司庫官在（第五十）五年（為）卡爾涅伊翁聖所之建造而預先支付之任何經費償還給司庫官。

No one is to propose a decree that these funds must be used for anything else. If so, the proposal must be void, and the proposer must be fined 2000 drachmae, and likewise the treasurer, double whatever was paid out and 2000 drachmae. It is necessary to supply the following: two white lambs before the beginning of the mysteries, a ram of healthy complexion for the purification, and three little pigs when one purifies in the theater, one hundred lambs on behalf of the first-time initiates, and in the procession, for Demeter, a pregnant sow, for the Great Gods, a two-year old heifer, a pig, for Hermes, a ram, for Apollo Karneios, a boar, and for Hagna, a sheep. And the contractor, having provided guarantors to the hieroi,
segments.zh: 應將祭牲之供應訂約外包，這些祭牲須在祕儀中獻祭並呈獻，以及那些用於淨罪之祭牲；訂約時，無論是將所有祭牲置於同一契約，或分開訂約，視何者適宜，均應交給願意接受最少金額之人。必須供應下列祭牲：祕儀開始前，兩頭白色羔羊；用於淨罪，一頭毛色健康的公羊；在劇場行淨罪禮時，三頭小豬；為首次入教者，一百頭羔羊；在遊行中，為得墨忒耳，一頭懷孕的母豬；為大神們，一頭兩歲的母犢、一頭豬；為赫爾墨斯，一頭公羊；為阿波羅‧卡爾涅伊俄斯，一頭公豬；為哈格娜，一頭綿羊。承包商在向聖職者提供保證人之後，

The hieroi are to put a mark on those approved, and the contractor must present the marked ones. If he does not present them for the scrutiny, the hieroi must exact from the guarantors the amount plus half, and they themselves must supply the animals and from the exacted funds recover the resulting expenditure for the animals. Concerning the Artists for the Dances The hieroi must appoint each year aulos- and kithara-players to perform in both the sacrifices and the mysteries, as many as they find who are capable, and those appointed in advance must perform
segments.zh: 必須領取款項，並呈獻非常神聖、潔淨、完整之動物，且在祕儀前十天將牠們展示給聖職者。聖職者應在通過檢驗的動物身上作標記，承包商必須呈獻這些作過標記的動物。若他未將牠們帶來接受檢驗，聖職者必須向保證人追討該金額及其一半，而他們自己必須供應動物，並從追討所得之款項中，收回因此產生的動物開支。關於舞蹈之藝人：聖職者每年必須指派奧洛斯笛手與基薩拉琴手，在獻祭與祕儀中表演，人數以他們所能找到的勝任者為準，而被事先指派者必須表演。

segments.en: for the gods. Concerning Crimes If someone in the days in which the sacrifices and the mysteries take place is caught either stealing or committing some other offense, he must be brought to the hieroi. A free man, if he is condemned, must pay back double, but a slave must be whipped and pay back double the theft, but for other offences the fine is 20 drachmae. If he does not pay immediately, the master must hand over his slave to the person damaged for working off the debt. If he does not, he is to be liable for double the amount. About Those Cutting (Wood) in the Sanctuary No one is to cut (wood) from the sacred place; and if anyone is caught, a slave must be flogged by the hieroi, but a free man must be fined as much as the hieroi decide. The one catching transgressors must bring
segments.zh: 以娛諸神。關於罪行：若有人在舉行獻祭與祕儀的那些日子裡，被發覺偷竊或犯下其他任何罪行，他必須被帶到聖職者面前。自由人，若被判有罪，必須加倍償還；奴隸則必須受鞭打，並加倍償還所竊之物；但對於其他罪行，罰款為二十德拉克馬。若他未立即支付，主人必須將他的奴隸交給受損害之人以勞役抵債。若他不這樣做，則須承擔雙倍金額之責任。關於在聖所內砍伐（木材）者：任何人不得從聖地砍伐（木材）；若有人被發覺，奴隸須由聖職者鞭打，自由人則須被處以聖職者所決定之罰款。捉拿違犯者之人必須將

segments.en: them to the hieroi and is to receive half (the fine). That There Be a Place of Refuge for Slaves The sanctuary must be a refuge for slaves, as the hieroi appoint the place, and no one is to harbor the fugitives or give them provisions or offer them work. Anyone acting contrary to what is written is to be liable to the master for twice the value of the slave and a fine of 500 drachmae. The priest must decide about the fugitives, whichever ones are sitting (in supplication) from our city, and whichever ones he condemns he must hand over to their masters. segments.zh: 聖職者與聖職女之〔誓言〕：議事會成員之書記必須在聖職者被任命後立即對其宣讀以下誓言，除非有人患病，並在獻祭焚燒之際奠血與酒：「我指著為之舉行祕儀的眾神起誓，我將確保入教期間的儀式以神聖且完全正確的方式進行，且我個人不會做出任何不當或錯誤之事以損害祕儀，也不會允許他人如此行，但我將服從」

segments.en: what is written and will swear in both the hierai and the priest according to the regulation. On the one hand, if I swear faithfully, may I have what the pious have, but if I swear falsely, the opposite.” If anyone does not want to take the oath, he is to be fined 1000 drachmae and must appoint someone else in his place by lot from the same tribe. The priest and the hieroi should administer the same oath to the hierai in the sanctuary of (Apollo) Karneios on the day before the mysteries and have them swear in addition: “And I have acted purely and properly in marriage with my husband.” The hieroi are to fine a woman who does not want to take the oath 1000 drachmae and not permit her to celebrate the sacrificial rituals or
segments.zh: 所書寫的內容，並將按照規章對聖職女與祭司同樣起誓。一方面，若我忠實起誓，願我得享虔誠者所得；若我虛假起誓，則得相反。」若有人不願起誓，應罰款一千德拉克馬，並必須從同一部落以抽籤方式指定他人代替其職。祭司與聖職者應在祕儀前一日於（阿波羅‧）卡爾涅伊俄斯聖所中對聖職女宣讀同樣的誓言，並令其額外起誓：「我與我丈夫在婚姻中行為純潔且合宜。」聖職者應對不願起誓的婦女罰款一千德拉克馬，且不許她參與獻祭儀式或

segments.en: take part in the mysteries, but those who have sworn are to celebrate. But hieroi and hierai appointed in the 55th year must swear the same oath in the Eleventh Month before the mysteries. Concerning Transferal The hieroi must hand over to those appointed as successors the container and books which Mnasistratos gave and also the rest of whatever has been furnished for the sake of the mysteries. Concerning Wreaths As wreaths, the hieroi and the hierai must wear a white felt cap, and of the initiates, the first-time initiates must wear tiaras. When the hieroi make the announcement, they must take off the tiaras and
segments.zh: 參與祕儀，但已起誓者應參與。然而，於第五十五年任命的聖職者與聖職女必須在第十一月祕儀前宣讀同樣的誓言。關於移交：聖職者必須將姆納西斯特拉托斯所交付的容器與書籍，以及為祕儀而備的其他一切物品，移交給被任命為繼任者的人。關於冠冕：作為冠冕，聖職者與聖職女必須佩戴白色氈帽，而在入教者中，初次入教者必須佩戴頭巾。當聖職者宣佈時，他們必須脫下頭巾，並

segments.en: all be wreathed with laurel. Concerning Clothes Those being initiated in the mysteries must be barefoot and wear white clothes, the women wearing neither transparent clothes nor borders on their mantels more than half a finger wide. And the ordinary women must wear a linen chiton and himation worth in total no more than 100 drachmae, the girls a long garment or a tunic and a worth in total no more than one mina, and the female slaves a long garment or a tunic and a mantel worth in total no more than 50 drachmae. Of the hierai, the adults must wear a long garment or a tunic without decorative motives and a mantel worth in total no more than two
segments.zh: 所有人都應戴上桂冠。關於衣著：入教者必須赤足，身穿白衣；婦女不得穿透明衣物，其披風的鑲邊不得寬於半指。普通婦女須穿亞麻長袍與披風，總值不得超過一百德拉克馬；少女須穿長袍或束腰外衣與披風，總值不得超過一邁納；女奴須穿長袍或束腰外衣與披風，總值不得超過五十德拉克馬。聖職女中，成年者須穿無紋飾的長袍或束腰外衣與披風，總值不得超過兩邁納；

segments.en: minas, and the [girls] a long garment and mantel worth in total no more than 100 drachmae. In the procession the hierai must wear a tunic and a wool woman’s mantel with borders no more than half half a finger wide, and the girls must wear a long garment and a mantel that is not transparent. No woman is to have gold, rouge, white lead make-up, a hair band, plaited hair, or shoes unless of felt or sacrificial leather. The hierai must have round wicker stools with white pillows or a white round cushion on them, having neither a decorative motive nor purple color. Whichever women are to dress themselves in representation of the deities must wear the clothes
segments.zh: 少女則穿長袍與披風，總值不得超過一百德拉克馬。在遊行中，聖職女須穿束腰外衣與羊毛婦女披風，鑲邊不得寬於半指；少女須穿長袍與不透明的披風。任何婦女不得佩戴黃金、胭脂、鉛白化妝品、髮帶、辮髮，或穿鞋，除非是氈製或祭牲皮革製的。聖職女須攜帶圓形柳條凳，上鋪白色坐墊或白色圓墊，不得有紋飾或紫色。凡要扮作神明的婦女，須穿聖職者所指定的衣服。

segments.en: which the hieroi order. If anyone otherwise has clothing contrary to the regulation, or if anyone has something else that is prohibited, the gynaikonomos must not allow the item and is to have the right to have it teared off, and it must become the property of the gods. Oath of the gynaikonomos The hieroi, when they themselves swear the oath, must swear in the gynaikonomos over the same sacrifices, to “certainly take care of the clothing and the rest of the matters enjoined upon me in the regulation”. Concerning the Procession In the procession Mnasistratos must lead, then the priest of the gods for whom the mysteries are celebrated in company with the priestess, then the agonothetes, the hierothytai, and the auletai. And after those, the hierai maidens, as
segments.zh: 若有人以其他方式穿著違反規定，或攜帶其他被禁止的物品，婦女監察官不得允許該物品，並有權將其撕下，該物品應歸神明所有。婦女監察官之誓詞：聖職者自己宣誓時，須在同一祭品上令婦女監察官宣誓：「必當照管衣物及規章中所吩咐我的其餘事項。」關於遊行：遊行中，姆納西斯特拉托斯須領隊，然後是為之舉行祕儀的神明的祭司與女祭司同行，然後是競技主持官、祭獻官與笛手。其後，聖職女少女按抽籤順序，引領載有聖物的箱子之馬車。

segments.en: allotted, leading the chariots with a casket set upon them containing the sacred objects. Then the female banquet-setter for (the sanctuary) of Demeter, and the assistant female banquet-setters having entered upon their office, then the priestess of Demeter at the Hippodrome, and then the (priestess of Demeter) in Aigila. Then the hierai, one by one, as allotted, then the hieroi, as the Ten Men arrange them. The gynaikonomos must allot the places of the hierai and the maidens, and is to see to it that they process as they were allotted. The sacrificial animals are also to be led in the procession, and they must sacrifice to Demeter, a pregnant sow, to Hermes, a ram, to the Great Gods, a heifer, a pig, to Apollo Karneios, a boar, and to Hagna, a sheep. Concerning Tents The hieroi must not allow anyone to have a tent in
segments.zh: 然後是得墨忒耳聖所的 female banquet-setter 及其助理 female banquet-setters（已就職者），然後是賽馬場的得墨忒耳女祭司，然後是埃吉拉的得墨忒耳女祭司。然後是聖職女，按抽籤順序逐一前行，然後是聖職者，按十人團的安排。婦女監察官須為聖職女與少女分配位置，並監督她們按分配的位置遊行。祭牲也須在遊行中牽引，並須向得墨忒耳獻祭一頭懷孕的母豬，向赫爾墨斯獻祭一頭公羊，向大神們獻祭一頭小母牛與一頭豬，向阿波羅‧卡爾涅伊俄斯獻祭一頭公豬，向哈格娜獻祭一頭羊。關於帳篷：聖職者不得允許任何人在大於三十呎的矩形內搭建帳篷，或將獸皮或帷幕掛在帳篷周圍；在聖職者劃定的區域內，非聖職者不得搭建帳篷。

segments.en: a rectangle greater than thirty feet or to put skins or hangings around the tents, and, in the area that the hieroi mark off, no one of those who are not hieroi is to have a tent. And they must not allow any uninitiated person into the place which they mark off. And they must also place lustral basins. And they must also write down from what one must be pure and what one must not have to enter. The Things Which One Must Not Have in the Tents No one shall have couches in the tent or silverware worth more than 300 drachmae. Otherwise, the hieroi must not allow it, and the extra must become property of the gods. Concerning Those Who Are Disorderly When the sacrifices and the mysteries are celebrated, everyone must keep religious silence
segments.zh: 他們也不得允許任何未入教者進入他們劃定的區域。他們還須放置淨水盆。他們還須寫明須潔淨之事及不得攜帶之物方可進入。帳篷內不得攜帶之物：任何人不得在帳篷內放置臥榻，或價值超過三百德拉克馬的銀器。否則，聖職者不得允許，超出的部分應歸神明所有。關於擾亂秩序者：當獻祭與祕儀舉行時，所有人須保持宗教肅靜，

segments.en: and obey orders. The hieroi must scourge anyone disobeying or conducting himself indecently toward the gods and ban him from the mysteries. Concerning Rhabdophoroi There are to be twenty rhabdophoroi appointed from the hieroi, and they must obey those carrying out the mysteries and take care that everything is done decorously and orderly by those attending, just as those appointed over them order. They must scourge those disobeying or conducting themselves indecently. If one of the rhabdophoroi does not do as is written, or if he commits some other wrong or does something to the detriment of the mysteries, having been judged in the presence of the hieroi, if found guilty, he is not
segments.zh: 並服從命令。聖職者須鞭打任何不服從或對神明行為不端者，並將其逐出祕儀。關於持杖者：須從聖職者中任命二十名持杖者，他們須服從主持祕儀者，並確保與會者一切行為端莊有序，正如被指派監督他們的人所命令的。他們須鞭打不服從或行為不端者。若持杖者中有人不按規定行事，或犯下其他過錯，或做出有損祕儀之事，經聖職者面前審判，若被判有罪，他不得……

segments.en: to participate in the mysteries. About Funds The Five chosen by the people must collect the funds accruing from the mysteries. All the archons by necessity must put forth nominations, not (of) the same person twice, each having assets of no less than a talent, and the gerousia must write (next to each name) the assets of those appointed, likewise also the assets of those who nominated them. The argyroskopos must serve those collecting the funds. When the mysteries are completed, they must give an account in all matters at the first regular assembly of the synedroi, and they must deliver the record to the epimeletes immediately, writing by heading the funds accrued
segments.zh: 參與祕儀。關於經費。人民選出的五人團必須收取祕儀所生之經費。全體執政官必須提出提名，不得（提名）同一人兩次，每人須擁有不少於一塔蘭同之資產，長老會必須（在每個名字旁）寫下被提名者之資產，亦須寫下提名者之資產。銀錢檢驗官必須服務於收取經費者。祕儀完成時，他們必須在議會成員的第一次常務會議上就所有事項作出報告，並必須立即將紀錄交給監督官，按項目寫明所收經費。

segments.en: from the purification and the entrance fee of the first-time initiates, and whatever else was accrued, and the expenditure which was made, and whatever, if anything, remains. They must pay it out immediately to the treasurer, and are to be held liable to judicial proceedings, if they are discovered doing something wrong, for a fine of double the amount and 1000 drachmae, and the judges must not reduce it at all. Those appointed in the 55th year must also pay out to Mnasistratos the funds granted [to him] by the city for the crown, 6000 drachmae. They must pay back to the treasurer whatever funds were paid out in advance by the treasurer in the [55th] year [for] the construction in the Karneiasion
segments.zh: 來自淨罪禮及初次入教者入門費之收入，以及其他一切收入，與所支出之費用，以及如有任何結餘。他們必須立即將其支付給司庫官，若被發現有任何不當行為，則須受司法審判，罰款為雙倍金額及一千德拉克馬，法官不得予以任何減免。第五十五年任命之人員亦必須將城市授予姆納西斯特拉托斯用於冠冕之經費六千德拉克馬支付給他。他們必須將司庫官在第五十五年為卡爾涅伊翁聖所之建造而預先支付之任何經費償還給司庫官。

segments.en: or expenditures for the mysteries. [The Five] must expend the [remainder of the advanced funds] for the repairs in the Karneiasion, and if there is need of [an addition to this] revenue, they must report, writing expressly for what there is a need, and the archons and synedroi must decree that the treasurer must [give] the funds. From what is accrued from the mysteries the funds must be restored to the treasurer, and they must deliver a report to the epimeletes about what they administer and are to be held liable to judicial proceedings if they commit some wrong, just as it is written above. The treasurer must write in a supplementary account whatever remainder he receives from these (funds) for the repair of the things in the
segments.zh: 或祕儀之開支。〔五人團〕必須將〔預付經費之結餘〕用於卡爾涅伊翁聖所之修繕，若此項收入需要〔追加〕，他們必須報告，明確寫明需要之用途，執政官與議會成員必須下令司庫官必須〔撥付〕該經費。從祕儀所得之經費中，必須償還司庫官，他們必須就其所管理之事項向監督官提交報告，若犯有過錯，須受司法審判，正如上文所寫。司庫官必須將他從這些（經費）中收到的用於修繕卡爾涅伊翁聖所內物品之任何結餘記入補充帳目。

segments.en: Karneiasion, and must not use it for anything else, until whatever funds are needed for the celebration of the mysteries are paid in full. No one is to propose a decree that these funds must be used for anything else. If so, the proposal must be void, and the proposer must be fined 2000 drachmae, and likewise the treasurer, double whatever was paid out and 2000 drachmae. And the judges must not reduce it at all, and the funds accrued from these judgments must go towards the repair of the things in the Karneiasion. When he pays in full whatever is necessary for the mysteries to be celebrated, the funds accrued from the mysteries must go towards the revenues of the city. Concerning the Supplying of Sacrificial Animals After their appointment, the hieroi,
segments.zh: 卡爾涅伊翁聖所，且不得挪作他用，直至慶祝祕儀所需之經費全部付清為止。任何人不得提議法令將此經費挪作他用。若有人提議，該提議必須無效，提議者須被罰款二千德拉克馬，司庫官亦同，罰款為已支付金額之雙倍及二千德拉克馬。法官不得予以任何減免，因這些判決所得之經費必須用於卡爾涅伊翁聖所內物品之修繕。當他付清慶祝祕儀所需之一切費用時，祕儀所得之經費必須歸入城市之收入。關於祭牲之供應。聖職者在任命之後，

segments.en: having advertised, are to contract out the supplying of sacrificial animals which must be sacrificed and presented in the mysteries and those (sacrificial animals) for the purifications, contracting out, whether it seems expedient for all the animals to be on the same contract or on separate contracts, to the one who offers to take the least sum. It is necessary to supply the following: two white lambs before the beginning of the mysteries, a ram of healthy complexion for the purification, and three little pigs when one purifies in the theater, one hundred lambs on behalf of the first-time initiates, and in the procession, for Demeter, a pregnant sow, for the Great Gods, a two-year old heifer, a pig, for Hermes, a ram, for Apollo Karneios, a boar, and for Hagna, a sheep. And the contractor, having provided guarantors to the hieroi,
segments.zh: 經公告後，必須將祕儀中須獻祭及呈獻之祭牲及用於淨罪禮之（祭牲）之供應承包出去，無論是將所有祭牲置於同一契約或分開契約，視何者適宜而定，承包給願接受最低金額者。必須供應以下祭牲：祕儀開始前兩頭白色羔羊，用於淨罪禮之一頭毛色健康之公羊，在劇場行淨罪禮時三頭小豬，代表初次入教者之一百頭羔羊，在遊行中，為得墨忒耳獻一頭懷孕母豬，為大神們獻一頭兩歲母犢、一頭豬，為赫爾墨斯獻一頭公羊，為阿波羅‧卡爾涅伊俄斯獻一頭公豬，為哈格娜獻一頭綿羊。承包商在向聖職者提供擔保人之後，

segments.en: must take the funds and present very holy, pure, whole animals and show them to the hieroi ten days before the mysteries. The hieroi are to put a mark on those approved, and the contractor must present the marked ones. If he does not present them for the scrutiny, the hieroi must exact from the guarantors the amount plus half, and they themselves must supply the animals and from the exacted funds recover the resulting expenditure for the animals. Concerning the Artists for the Dances The hieroi must appoint each year aulos- and kithara-players to perform in both the sacrifices and the mysteries, as many as they find who are capable, and those appointed in advance must perform
segments.zh: 必須領取經費，並呈獻非常神聖、潔淨、完整之動物，且在祕儀前十天將它們展示給聖職者。聖職者必須在合格者身上作標記，承包商必須呈獻已作標記者。若他未將它們呈交檢驗，聖職者必須向擔保人索取金額外加一半，他們自己必須供應動物，並從索取之經費中收回由此產生之動物開支。關於舞蹈之藝人。聖職者每年必須任命吹笛者與彈基薩拉琴者，在獻祭及祕儀中表演，人數視其所能找到之勝任者而定，先前被任命者必須表演。

segments.en: for the gods. Concerning Crimes If someone in the days in which the sacrifices and the mysteries take place is caught either stealing or committing some other offense, he must be brought to the hieroi. A free man, if he is condemned, must pay back double, but a slave must be whipped and pay back double the theft, but for other offences the fine is 20 drachmae. If he does not pay immediately, the master must hand over his slave to the person damaged for working off the debt. If he does not, he is to be liable for double the amount. About Those Cutting (Wood) in the Sanctuary No one is to cut (wood) from the sacred place; and if anyone is caught, a slave must be flogged by the hieroi, but a free man must be fined as much as the hieroi decide. The one catching transgressors must bring
segments.zh: 為諸神。關於罪行：若有人在獻祭與祕儀舉行之際，被當場捉獲偷竊或犯下其他過錯，他必須被帶到聖職者面前。自由人若被判有罪，須加倍償還；奴隸則須受鞭打，並加倍償還所竊之物；至於其他過錯，罰款為二十德拉克馬。若他未立即支付，主人必須將他的奴隸交給受損害之人以勞役抵債。若他不這樣做，他須承擔加倍金額之責任。關於在聖所內（砍伐）木材者：任何人不得從聖地砍伐（木材）；若有人被當場捉獲，奴隸須由聖職者鞭打，自由人則須繳納聖職者所決定的罰款。捉獲違犯者之人必須將他們帶至

segments.en: them to the hieroi and is to receive half (the fine). That There Be a Place of Refuge for Slaves The sanctuary must be a refuge for slaves, as the hieroi appoint the place, and no one is to harbor the fugitives or give them provisions or offer them work. Anyone acting contrary to what is written is to be liable to the master for twice the value of the slave and a fine of 500 drachmae. The priest must decide about the fugitives, whichever ones are sitting (in supplication) from our city, and whichever ones he condemns he must hand over to their masters. But if he does not hand over, the master is allowed to go away in possession (of him). About the Fountain Mnasistratos must take care of the fountain named “Hagna” by the ancient writings and
segments.zh: 聖職者處，並可獲得（罰款）之一半。關於為奴隸設立避難所：聖所必須作為奴隸的避難所，正如聖職者所指派的地點；任何人不得窩藏逃亡者、供給他們糧食或提供他們工作。凡違反所寫規定者，須對奴隸的主人承擔奴隸價值兩倍之責任，並處以五百德拉克馬之罰款。祭司必須裁決這些逃亡者，即那些從我們城中前來（懇求）而坐於此者；凡他判定有罪者，他必須將他們交給其主人。但若他不交出，主人有權將（他）帶走。關於水泉：姆納西斯特拉托斯必須照看那被古代文獻稱為「哈格娜」的水泉，以及

segments.en: the statue located near the fountain as long as he lives, and he is to share in both the sacrifices and mysteries with the hieroi. Mnasistratos is to receive whatever those sacrificing at the fountain offer on the table and the skins of the sacrificial animals. Mnasistratos is to receive a one-third share of the income from whatever those sacrificing at the fountain offer or put into the treasury, when it is constructed. The other two portions and any dedication set up by those sacrificing are to be property of the gods. The priest and the hieroi must take care that from the funds dedications are made for the gods, whatever ones are decided by the synedroi. Concerning the Construction of Money-boxes
segments.zh: 位於水泉附近的雕像，終其一生；他須與聖職者一同分享獻祭與祕儀。姆納西斯特拉托斯須收取那些在水泉獻祭者所供奉於桌上的物品及祭牲的皮。當庫房建成時，姆納西斯特拉托斯須從那些在水泉獻祭者所供奉或投入庫房的收入中收取三分之一份額。其餘兩份及獻祭者所設立之任何還願奉獻，均屬諸神之財產。祭司與聖職者必須確保從這些資金中，按照議會成員所決定的項目，為諸神製作奉獻物。關於錢箱之建造：

segments.en: The hieroi appointed in the 55th year must see to it, along with the architect, that two stone lockable money-boxes are built, and they must place one in the temple of the Great Gods and the other near the fountain, in whatever place seems safe to them. And they must install keys (locking devices); for the one by the fountain, Mnasistratos is to have one key and the hieroi the other, and for the one in the temple, the hieroi are to have the key. They must open them each year at the mysteries and report the income counted out from each treasury, writing them separately. And they must give to Mnasistratos the income belonging to him, as
segments.zh: 於第五十五年任命之聖職者，必須與建築師一同負責建造兩個石製可上鎖的錢箱；他們必須將一個置於大神們的神廟中，另一個置於水泉附近，置於他們認為安全之處。他們必須安裝鑰匙（鎖具）；對於水泉旁的那個，姆納西斯特拉托斯持有一把鑰匙，聖職者持有另一把；對於神廟中的那個，聖職者持有鑰匙。他們必須每年在祕儀期間打開錢箱，並將從每個庫房清點出的收入分開記錄呈報。他們必須將屬於姆納西斯特拉托斯的收入交給他，正如

segments.en: it is written in the regulation. Concerning the Sacred Meal The hieroi, after removing the customary [portions] for the gods from each of the sacrificial animals led in the procession, must use the [rest] of the meat for the sacred meal, with the hierai and the maidens, and they must invite the priest [and the] priestess [and the] priestess of (Apollo) Karneios and Mnasistratos and both his wife and his children and those serving as artists in the dances and those serving as their helpers. And for the rest of the expenses they must make no greater expenditure than [...] drachmae. Concerning the Agora The hieroi must appoint a place in which all things will be sold. The agoranomos for the city
segments.zh: 法規中所記載。關於神聖宴席：聖職者在從遊行中所引領的每頭祭牲中，為諸神取下慣常的〔份額〕之後，必須將〔其餘〕肉用於神聖宴席，與聖職女及少女們一同享用；他們必須邀請祭司〔與〕女祭司〔與〕（阿波羅‧）卡爾涅伊俄斯的女祭司、姆納西斯特拉托斯及其妻子與兒女、以及在舞蹈中擔任藝人者及其助手。至於其餘開銷，他們不得花費超過〔……〕德拉克馬。關於市集：聖職者必須指定一個地點，所有物品將在此出售。城市的市場監察官

segments.en: must take care that the sellers sell things unadulterated and pure and use weights and measures that coincide with the public ones, but he must neither fix the price at which they must sell, nor set the time, and no one is to charge the sellers anything for the space. Those who do not sell as written, he must scourge if they are slaves, but fine 20 drachmae if they are free men. And the judgment must be in the presence of the hieroi. Concerning Water The agoranomos must also have responsibility for the water, so that during the time of the panegyris no one damages the sluice or the channels or anything else is constructed in the sanctuary for the sake of water, and so that the water runs just as it is allotted and
segments.zh: 必須確保賣家出售之物品純淨無摻雜，並使用與公共度量衡一致的度量衡；但他不得規定他們必須出售的價格，也不得設定時間；任何人不得向賣家收取攤位空間之費用。凡不按所寫規定出售者，若為奴隸，他須鞭打之；若為自由人，則處以二十德拉克馬之罰款。裁決必須在聖職者面前進行。關於水：市場監察官亦須負責水之事宜，以確保在節慶集會期間，無人損壞水閘、水道或聖所內為水而建造的任何其他設施，並確保水按照分配的方式流淌，且

segments.en: no one hinders those using it. If he catches someone doing something prohibited, he must flog him, if a slave, or [fine] him 20 drachmae, if a free man, and the judgment must be in the presence of the hieroi. Concerning Ointments and Bath The agoranomos must take care that those wanting [to manage] the bath in the sanctuary do not charge the bathers more than two chalkoi and supply fire and a temperate communal bathtub and temperate water to those washing themselves down, and that the one contracted to supply wood to the anointing room supplies dry wood sufficient for those anointing themselves every day from the fourth hour to the seventh. No slave is to anoint himself. The hieroi contract out the furnishing of wood
segments.zh: 無人阻礙使用它的人。若他抓到某人做被禁止之事，若是奴隸，他必須鞭打他；若是自由人，則〔罰〕他二十德拉克馬，且判決必須在聖職者面前進行。關於油膏與沐浴：市場監督官必須注意，那些想要〔管理〕聖所中沐浴的人，不得向沐浴者收取超過兩個卡爾科斯，並須供應火、一個溫和的公共浴池，以及溫和的水給那些沖洗身體的人；且被約定供應油膏室木材的人，必須每天從第四時辰到第七時辰，供應足夠的乾柴給那些自行塗油者。任何奴隸不得自行塗油。聖職者將供應木材之事訂約外包。

segments.en: to the anointing room. If any contractor or bath manager does not do as is written, the agoranomos must flog him, if a slave, or fine him, if a free man, 20 drachmae for each offence, and the judgment must be in the presence of the hieroi. Concerning the Report of the decisions The hieroi, whatever matters they administer in the panegyris or whatever judgments they impose on some people, they must report the decisions to the prytaneion. And they must also inscribe [on] the building in the sanctuary which people they sentence and for what offense. That There Be a Copy of the Regulation Those appointed to write up the regulation, just as it is approved, must give a copy to the nomodeiktai. Those receiving it
segments.zh: 給油膏室。若任何承包商或浴池管理者不按所寫行事，市場監督官必須鞭打他，若是奴隸；或罰他，若是自由人，每一項違規罰二十德拉克馬，且判決必須在聖職者面前進行。關於決議的報告：聖職者，無論他們在泛希臘集會中管理何事，或對某些人施加何種判決，他們必須將決議報告給市政廳。他們也必須在聖所中的建築物上刻寫，他們判決了哪些人，以及因何罪行。關於規章須有一份副本：被指定抄寫規章的人，正如它被批准的那樣，必須將一份副本交給律法展示者。接收它的人

segments.en: must show it to one who needs it. And in the mysteries, the herald, auletes, seer, and architect must serve jointly with the hieroi. Concerning the Appointment of the Ten On the twelth of the Sixth Month, before the time of the allotment of the hieroi and the hierai takes place, the damiourgoi must allow the people a vote
segments.zh: 必須將它展示給需要的人。而在祕儀中，傳令官、笛手、預言者與建築師必須與聖職者共同服務。關於十人團的任命：在第六月的第十二日，在聖職者與聖職女的抽籤時間之前，造物官必須允許人民投票
